name: Upright Commercial Vacuum
definition: An operator-guided commercial dry vacuum whose floor head, driven or passive brush system, dirt path and upright body move as one assembly across carpet or approved hard floors.
includedScope: Single- and dual-motor commercial brush uprights
primaryApplications: Approved mixed carpet and hard-floor routes
headline: Upright commercial vacuum brush systems, filtration and buyer verification
description: This technical profile explains commercial upright vacuum architecture, brush and nozzle variants, carpet and hard-floor boundaries, filtration, operator handling and comparable test limits.
metaDescription: Upright commercial vacuum guide covering brush rolls, carpet pickup, filtration, representative models and procurement checks.
disclaimer: This is an independent category reference, not cleaning-performance, indoor-air, ergonomic, electrical-safety or certification advice. Verify the exact regional product, brush setting, surface approval, filter and bag configuration, battery or cable, and service parts.

keyFacts.label: System boundary
keyFacts.value: Floor head, brush roll, airflow path, bag or container, filters, motor and handle
keyFacts.evidence: Official product pages and manuals identify these linked systems on reviewed uprights.
keyFacts.scope: Functional synthesis; single- and dual-motor layouts differ.

keyFacts.label: Surface boundary
keyFacts.value: Brush height and hard-floor suitability are model-specific
keyFacts.evidence: Nilfisk documents self-adjusting brush height while other manufacturers publish model-specific brush or squeegee arrangements.
keyFacts.scope: Exact carpet pile, hard floor and machine setting.

keyFacts.label: Performance boundary
keyFacts.value: Airflow, vacuum, watts, brush width and productivity do not measure the same result
keyFacts.evidence: Official specifications report different metrics and ASTM F608 defines a controlled embedded-dirt method.

keyFacts.label: Filtration boundary
keyFacts.value: A filter label does not establish whole-machine emissions or delivered configuration
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific filter stages and ASTM identifies separate vacuum emissions methods.
keyFacts.scope: Exact filter, seals, bag, maintenance state and test method.

systemFlow.name: Surface agitation
systemFlow.role: Loosens embedded or surface soil and presents it to the inlet.
systemFlow.evidence: Reviewed uprights document roller brushes and brush adjustment.
systemFlow.scope: Exact carpet, brush and height setting.

systemFlow.name: Pickup
systemFlow.role: Admits debris and air from the cleaning path.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources publish working widths and floor-head features.
systemFlow.scope: Edge result and debris size remain test-specific.

systemFlow.name: Transport and collection
systemFlow.componentFamily: Internal duct, hose and dust bag
systemFlow.evidence: Reviewed models document bags, stretch hoses or onboard tools.
systemFlow.scope: Exact bag code and blockage access.

systemFlow.name: Filtration
systemFlow.role: Protects the motor and limits exhaust particles according to configuration.
systemFlow.evidence: Nilfisk and Tornado identify H13 or HEPA stages on named models.
systemFlow.scope: No whole-machine filtration equivalence is inferred.

systemFlow.name: Power and operator control
systemFlow.componentFamily: Mains cable or battery, handle and switches
systemFlow.role: Supplies energy and governs movement and cleaning.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish cord, battery, handle and weight data.
systemFlow.scope: Regional electrical or delivered battery kit.

variants.name: Single-motor upright
variants.operatorRelationship: One motor drives suction with the brush arrangement defined by the model
variants.spaceConstraints: Upright storage but limited reach under low furniture
variants.limitations: Motor count alone does not establish pickup or service life.
variants.evidence: Tornado documents CK 14/1 Pro as a single-motor upright.

variants.name: Dual-motor brush upright
variants.taskScale: Commercial carpet routes with separately driven brush system
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator adjusts or monitors brush engagement according to the model
variants.spaceConstraints: Wider or heavier head can affect turns and stairs
variants.limitations: Dual motors do not establish a superior result on every carpet.
variants.evidence: Kärcher publishes two motors and roller-brush adjustment for CV 38/2 Adv.

variants.name: Battery upright
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator manages state of charge and battery swaps
variants.spaceConstraints: Charging, battery storage and runtime planning are required
variants.limitations: Stated runtime varies with battery condition and duty.
variants.evidence: Truvox publishes a lithium-ion battery upright with stated runtime and charging time.
variants.scope: Valet Battery Upright II brochure configuration.

performanceMetrics.name: Cleaning width
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports aisle fit and pass planning
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Nominal head width does not include edge effectiveness
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Wider heads may require more turning effort.

performanceMetrics.name: Embedded carpet dirt removal
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Can support controlled comparison when tested to the same method
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: ASTM F608 uses standardized carpet and dirt in a laboratory
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not convert manufacturer positioning into an F608 result.
performanceMetrics.evidence: ASTM publishes the test scope and limitations.
performanceMetrics.scope: Laboratory embedded dirt, not surface litter or site productivity.

performanceMetrics.name: Airflow and vacuum
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Neither alone establishes floor-head pickup under loading.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Kärcher and Tornado publish model-specific air data.

performanceMetrics.name: Filtration and emissions
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Filter grade, whole-machine leakage and room particle generation are different tests
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A HEPA component claim is not a room-air outcome.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers and ASTM distinguish filtration and emissions measures.

performanceMetrics.name: Mass, sound and reach
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports handling, occupied-space and route planning
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Sound method, machine-only mass, cable and battery definitions differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Catalogue values do not replace an operator trial.

applicationFit.evidence: Nilfisk explicitly positions VU500 for medium and low cut pile with automatic brush-height adjustment.
applicationFit.scope: Named model and approved carpet types.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Actual pile response, grooming and pickup should be verified on the buyer's carpet.
applicationFit.limitations: No universal carpet compatibility is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Trial every representative carpet and inspect appearance, pickup and brush loading.

applicationFit.evidence: Nilfisk official imagery and commercial positioning show VU500 in hotel environments.
applicationFit.scope: Ordinary approved dry debris and carpet.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Under-bed reach, cable moves, tool changes and sound should be timed on an actual room route.
applicationFit.limitations: Scene imagery is not performance proof.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Run an occupied-room and corridor trial with the delivered tools.

applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers position reviewed uprights for demanding commercial cleaning and publish manoeuvrability or onboard-tool features.
applicationFit.scope: Approved surfaces and ordinary dry debris.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Turning around fixtures, edge cleaning and cable or battery logistics determine route fit.
applicationFit.limitations: No independent productivity ranking was reviewed.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Map a representative route and record turns, stops, edge rework and consumables.

applicationFit.evidence: Truvox documents a squeegee and hard-floor use for its battery upright while other products require exact surface confirmation.
applicationFit.scope: Only models and settings officially approved for the surface.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Brush roll and nozzle design can scatter debris or affect sensitive finishes.
applicationFit.limitations: Upright category naming does not establish hard-floor suitability.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Obtain written surface approval and test debris pickup without marking or scatter.

componentStack.name: Floor head and brush roll
componentStack.role: Agitates and admits soil across the cleaning path.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources document model-specific brush and nozzle systems.

componentStack.name: Air path and above-floor tools
componentStack.role: Carries debris and supports detail cleaning.
componentStack.evidence: Nilfisk and Tornado list stretch hoses and onboard tools.

componentStack.name: Bag and collection chamber
componentStack.evidence: Official manuals and product pages identify model-specific bags.

componentStack.name: Filter and seals
componentStack.role: Limit dust passing through the exhaust according to configuration.

componentStack.name: Drive, handle and power
componentStack.role: Supports operator movement, brush drive and suction power.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources distinguish motor and power arrangements.

representativeModels.evidence: Kärcher publishes the exact model and cited data.

distinguishingSpecifications: Standard certified H13 HEPA filter on reviewed EU page
representativeModels.evidence: Nilfisk publishes the exact product page and features.

distinguishingSpecifications: H13 HEPA filter on reviewed EU page
representativeModels.evidence: Nilfisk publishes the exact 15-inch family page.
Lindhaus publishes the model in its official manual.
representativeModels.scope: Manual identifies multiple voltage and width variants.

representativeModels.evidence: Tornado publishes the exact model and cited specifications.
Truvox publishes the named battery upright and cited features.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Achieved pickup, brush response, edge result and operator effort
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by motor watts or nominal width alone
procurementDecisions.evidence: ASTM and manufacturers separate cleaning method from catalogue metrics.
procurementDecisions.scope: Actual carpet, debris and delivered machine.
procurementDecisions.assessment: A timed carpet trial should decide route fit.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No independent model ranking is provided.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Trial representative carpet with measured soil, turns, edges and rework.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Inspect brush setting, belt or drive, airflow path and bag loading.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Sound, cable or battery logistics, manoeuvrability and filtration configuration
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating a filter grade or brochure sound number as an occupied-space outcome
procurementDecisions.evidence: Sources publish model-specific sound, power and filter features.
procurementDecisions.assessment: People, acoustics and route obstacles must be included in acceptance.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Catalogue data cannot reproduce site acoustics.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Run an occupied-area trial and approve noise, cable visibility and exhaust condition.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm filter, bag, cable or charger part numbers.

procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming every upright can transition safely between surfaces
procurementDecisions.evidence: Only selected manufacturers document automatic adjustment or hard-floor features.
procurementDecisions.scope: Actual floor finishes and model settings.
procurementDecisions.assessment: The purchase specification should name surfaces and permitted settings.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Test scatter, marking, pickup and brush contact on every surface.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify brush material, adjustment and squeegee or shutoff features.

engineeringChecks.check: Brush roll, height and surface approval
engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect contact can reduce pickup or damage carpet and finishes.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Document the approved setting and brush code for each surface.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturers distinguish adjustment and surface features.

engineeringChecks.check: Air path, bag and filter seals
engineeringChecks.reason: Blockages or poor sealing change pickup and emissions.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect blockage access, bag fit, filters and seals during acceptance.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources document bags, hoses and filter stages.

engineeringChecks.reason: Route reach and runtime affect productivity and safety.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Map outlets or charging windows and record actual route runtime.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturers publish cord and battery data.

engineeringChecks.reason: Handle force, stairs, turning and tool-free maintenance affect sustainable use.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Include multiple operators in the trial and time routine service tasks.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources publish ergonomic and tool-free maintenance features.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-69:2021
standards.applicability: Safety of commercial wet and dry vacuum cleaners, including power-brush equipment.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the commercial vacuum scope.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and exact product conformity.

standards.name: ASTM F608-24
standards.applicability: Laboratory evaluation of carpet embedded-dirt removal for household and commercial upright, canister and combination vacuum cleaners.
standards.evidence: ASTM publishes the active standard scope.
standards.scope: Embedded dirt under specified laboratory conditions; not site productivity or surface litter.

developments.title: IEC commercial vacuum safety edition published
developments.evidence: The IEC catalogue records the date and scope.

developments.title: ASTM F608-24 became the active embedded-dirt method
developments.summary: ASTM lists F608-24 as the active version for household and commercial vacuum carpet embedded-dirt evaluation.
developments.evidence: ASTM's committee page lists the active standard.
developments.scope: Laboratory method, not a minimum rating.
